liam: Heads-up: CI red on PR 4827 — integration/session-timeout failing 3x in a row on linux-py38 matrix. Noticed same shard. Don't want a full rebuild. Any quick way to retrigger only that step?
nina: You can trigger a targeted rerun w/o rebuilding images: `./dev/ci rerun --job=integration/session-timeout --shard=linux-py38 --no-image` — that hits the same job/step in Buildkite. Also `--preserve-kv-cache` if you want artifacts kept.
buildkite-bot: Rerun command received: starting build 98765 — https://ci.redwood.com/builds/98765 :rocket:
liam: thx nina, running it now
buildkite-bot: Build 98765 finished: session-timeout still failed (1 failure). Suggestion: try `--preserve-kv-cache` or a smoke run first.
omar: If it keeps flaking across reruns, consider a bisect: `./dev/ci bisect --job=integration --test=session-timeout --start-commit=<sha> --end-commit=<sha>` — that'll narrow the culprit commit. Otherwise try the smoke run: `./dev/ci smoke --shard=linux-py38 integration/session-timeout` to validate quickly.
nina: Another quick trick: rerun the single step via the web UI > build > step > re-run step (no image rebuild) — handy if you prefer the UI.
liam: Smoke run passed, full step still flaky. I'll kick off a bisect and loop infra in if it persists. pinging @nina @omar for visibility :thumbsup:
